messages:
alex: Heads-up — we just hit 85% usage on eu-west-dedicated pool for H100s. Can the vendor ETA be tightened? We need 40 units by next week or we start throttling customers.

natalie_vendor: we can push priority on the 40 but current leadtime from the manufacturer is 12–16 business days. I asked for a small airlift quote. waiting on freight ETA (+ customs). :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

marta_ops: If we go air, what's the delta vs sea? rough $/unit? need numbers to approve.

natalie_vendor: prelim numbers: sea = $0 landed cost baseline; air = +$1.1k/unit incl expedited courier, customs brokerage estimate. exact after AWB quote.

devon_infra: quick ask — of the 40, can we accept a mixed allocation (32 H100, 8 H200-equivalent replacement credits)? We can remap some jobs if needed.

natalie_vendor: mixing ok but H200 availability is tight too. Vendor offered 8 credit swaps at -$400/unit discount but longer leadtime for H200 hardware.

alex: tradeoff: we can accept mixed if we get 32 actual H100s by next week. The 8 credits can be scheduled for later.

marta_ops: also consider depot throughput — last time depot had a 3-day backlog causing labels/AWB mismatch. If air, need depot slot windows. who owns depot booking?

natalie_vendor: vendor handles carrier -> depot handoff but we need your depot SLA slot confirmation. I can hold the air quote for 24h.

alex: @marta_ops can you confirm earliest depot slot window for air arrivals? we need to lock quote today.

marta_ops: checking now. Depot reports an opening on 03/28 (ETA 04/01 delivery -> inbound processing 04/02). if air arrives before 03/29 we can process same-day. otherwise 48h triage.

devon_infra: heads-up: if processing slides, we may bump scheduled maintenance windows. I can free a few servers by shedding lower-priority queues.

natalie_vendor: AWB mock: AWB 125-EXP-789, carrier: SwiftAir. customs docs ready but vendor flagged potential HS code reclass for h100 fam — might add 1–2 day hold in FRA.

alex: can vendor add insurance + expedite customs handling to the quote? we'll absorb if it avoids a 2-day hold.

natalie_vendor: yes, expedite customs handler + premium insurance adds ~$12k total to shipment. splits to ~$300/unit.

marta_ops: math: air delta (~$1100) + customs expedite (~$300) -> ~$1400/unit incremental. compare vs doing partial sea + burst from us vs throttling.

devon_infra: cost of throttling: estimated lost revenue/risky SLAs ~ $3k/day until capacity freed. If air saves us 2 days, that quickly offsets cost.

alex: agree. proceed with air + customs expedite if vendor can guarantee pick/air on vendor side within 24h and depot slot 03/28 holds.

natalie_vendor: will confirm carrier pickup by EOD and send pro forma invoice. holding AWB and cargo docs.

marta_ops: also escalate RMA queue — we currently have 22 RMA units pending at depot for serial mismatch. If depot is overloaded, returns will back up into the fleet and reduce usable capacity. need a separate RMA expedite plan.

natalie_vendor: we can prioritize RMA processing on the same air manifest if customers approve combined handling. vendor can pre-clear returns paperwork to speed depot acceptance.

devon_infra: critical note: last batch had BIOS firmware mismatch causing partial DOA. please ensure replacement units pass the depot firmware QA before shipment. we will refuse units that fail basic POST.

natalie_vendor: noted — we'll run depot QA checklist (POST/log capture) and provide a quick acceptance report per unit. also pre-tag serials in the manifest to match return labels to avoid mismatch.

alex: perfect. final ask: create a short runbook for ops with steps for inbound air, depot triage, RMA pairing, and fallbacks if customs hold. I can sign off.

marta_ops: i'll draft the runbook and post it here. outline includes: 1) AWB tracking + contact, 2) depot slot & triage coords, 3) RMA serial pairing script, 4) rollback plan to shed non-critical tenants.

supplybot: [shipment_tracker] Shipment 125-EXP-789 status: quote_requested -> quote_received -> awaiting_pickup_confirmation. ETA estimates: pickup 24–48h, arrival eu-west 72–96h after pickup.

natalie_vendor: pickup confirmed 18:00 UTC tonight if we approve insurance. sending PI now.

alex: approved. proceed with air + expedite customs + depot QA holdback. thanks all. :thumbsup:

marta_ops: on it — will post runbook by 16:00 UTC and coordinate depot.

devon_infra: i'll prepare the shedding plan and email SRE on-call.

natalie_vendor: PI sent, payment terms as discussed. will update AWB when picked up.

alex: closing note — keep RMA lanes clear. if any serial mismatches show up during depot QA, vendor to return to vendor QC and replace before handoff. no partial acceptance.

natalie_vendor: understood. we'll add 'replace-before-hand-off' clause to the PI.

alex: thanks team.
